_about: Rev3.0 OVEN CONTROLLER carrier frame v2 (continuous flange, 10 M4 stud bosses). Built natively in Fusion 360 by Design Reports/Rev3.0/tools/frame_v2/fusion/NN_*.py. Units mm / deg. Plan coordinates abs KiCad (x, y down); model Y = -y; Z = 0 at the physical PCB back.
revision: v2.2 final (2026-11-13; frame v6 FINAL, assembly v6 with both sheet peg holes X-slots): v2.1 (socket rule 6.5/11.0, symmetric 7.5/14, slots 4.5 x 5.3, tail walls stepped at y 129, ribs to the shelf edge, hole shift) + stud tubes 5 above the flange back (seat Z -3.52, full-height ribs, PEM FH-M4-18), pegs on the side flanges, radial slots

thermal.kinematics_note: v2.2 final (owner decision): both sheet peg holes are X-slots, so the pegs fix only the y = 69.5 line and the rotation; x is located by the stud slots themselves (FH2/FH7 radial = Y-slots, 0.25 across-clearance in x) -> the frame grows about the pattern centre within +-0.25 and the datum case applies; peg-to-peg growth 0.645 is shared by the two slots (0.35 travel each). P1_fixed_case_* columns kept for reference only (superseded)
thermal.glass_location: y +-0.1 by the pegs (dia 3 in 3.2-wide slots), x +-0.25 by the studs

oven_sheet.stud_holes: 10 x round dia 4.3 (PEM FH-M4-18 clinch studs) at fh1..fh10
oven_sheet.peg_holes: P1 and P2: slot 3.2 x 3.9 along X (sheet_peg_hole 3.2 + sheet_peg_slot 0.7)

stud_hole_geometry.stud_boss_h_semantics: tube height ABOVE THE FLANGE BACK (v2.2)
stud_hole_geometry.rib: one radial rib per tube, rib 1.5, full tube height (flange back -> tube top), 1 deg

support_ribs.rule: v1 positions/widths; free ends run to the shelf edge (window face) and, over the tail pocket, to the shelf end, trimmed flush by those cuts; kept at v1 length if a B.Cu pad would come closer than 1.0 mm

Root fillets R0.5 - PCB bosses on the walls

lift_calc.method: unfolded stud-line runs, simply supported, gasket line load where the glass edge runs alongside (exact) + uniform-share upper bound; I about own centroid
lift_calc.eight_hole_result: v2.1 rules (6.5 from outline, 11.0 from H1..H9, 15 from corners): best 8-hole layout 178.1 um exact (T2 R2 L2 B2) > 90 -> 10 holes (v2.0: 219 um)

checks.q1_note: Q1 TO-220 as modelled has untrimmed 8.1 mm leads (zmin -8.115): 0.54 mm3 through the Formex sheet; trimmed to <= 2.5 mm (mandatory assembly step) -> 2.10 mm to the sheet. Q1 to the frame: 32.72 mm.

creepage.note: v1 method; extended ribs remove the 0.5 shelf land from the path (v2.0: 8.52 mm)

checks.tail_corner_R0_3_attempt: R0.3 fillet on the 2 tail-pocket corners rose to Z -1.919 (0.18 above the shelf back, tight edge/face sampling) -> deleted, corners stay sharp
